title: category
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): lk_category_createdby, lk_category_createdonbehalfby, lk_category_modifiedby, lk_category_modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, parentcategoryid, transactioncurrencyid.

categorynumber.description: Shows the category number for customer reference.

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

description.description: Type a detailed description of the category

exchangerate.description: Shows the conversion rate of the record's currency.

importsequencenumber.description: Unique identifier of the data import or data migration that created this record.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

sequencenumber.description: Enter a number to define the display position of the category in the hierarchy.

title.description: Type a title for the Category.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.

_ownerid_value.description: Enter the user or team who is assigned to manage the record.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Shows the business unit that the record owner belongs to.

_parentcategoryid_value.description: Select an existing category article for the category.

_transactioncurrencyid_value.description: Choose the local currency for the record to make sure budgets are reported in the correct currency.
